basic_profile.bio: Just a gamer rediscovering the nostalgic classics. I grew up playing video games but only recently found time to revisit some iconic titles like Metal Gear Solid. I'm based in Austin, Texas, working as a freelance graphic designer. I usually browse Reddit late at night or during my coffee breaks. I'm single and spend most of my free time gaming or exploring new hobbies. Currently dealing with ADHD, which makes me hyperfocus on certain interests. My dislikes include overly negative people and unnecessary drama.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming and design, with a keen interest in retro games and their evolution. Recently started exploring the Metal Gear Solid series more deeply, prompted by discussions in gaming communities. I occasionally research topics related to ADHD, which I was diagnosed with last year.
